```{r}
install.packages("fortunes")
```
```{r}
library(fortunes)
```
```{r}
#numeric vector practise
my_first_vector <- c(1, 5, 9)
print(my_first_vector)
#character vector practise
character_vec <- c("hello", "this", "is", "a", "character", "vector")
print(character_vec)
#logical vector practise
logical_vec <- c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
print(logical_vec)
#putting existing variables into one vector
x <- 1
y <- 2
z <- 3

xyz_vec <- c(x, y, z)
#One-based indexing
nice_food <- c("cheese", "beans", "potatoes")

print(nice_food[1])
print(nice_food[2])
print(nice_food[3])
#core exercise
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
pet<- all_my_pets[4]
print(pet)
```
```{r}
#data frame intoduction
install.packages("gt")
```
```{r}
fruits <- c("apple", "pear", "banana")
lengths <- c(22, 30, 55)
weights <- c(150, 165, 170)

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = fruits,
  length = lengths,
  weight = weights
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
```


```{r}
library(tibble)
fruits <- c("apple", "pear", "banana")
lengths <- c(22, 30, 55)
weights <- c(150, 165, 170)

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = fruits,
  length = lengths,
  weight = weights
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(cell_ID = c("CX1","CX2"),treated=c(TRUE,FALSE),num_cells_before=c(5413,8123),num_cells_after=c(1432,7543))
gt(my_data_frame)
```
